guitar.guitaristsText: Jonny Greenwood / Ed O'Brien / Thom Yorke
guitar.modelsText: Fender Telecaster Plus / Fender Stratocaster / Yairi acoustic
guitar.evidence: Jonny Greenwood uses his famous Fender Telecaster Plus (equipped with a Lace Sensor Blue neck pickup and a Lace Sensor Dually Red humbucker in the bridge) and a Marshall ShredMaster overdrive for the crushing distortion sounds. For the clean, modulated effects, he plays through a Fender Twin Reverb, while his distorted tones run through a Vox AC30. Ed O'Brien provides the ambient textures using single-coil Stratocasters and specific processing, and Thom Yorke plays the acoustic rhythm track.
guitar.notes: The original profile was accurate regarding the guitar choices but lacked the distinction that Jonny's signature dirt comes from an aggressive high-gain distortion pedal (ShredMaster) pushing a Vox/Fender, rather than a fuzz pedal.
guitar.source: The King of Gear (Radiohead gear archive), interviews with Jonny Greenwood and Nigel Godrich.

tone.target: Ultra-clean compressed arpeggios transitioning to aggressive, sharp high-gain distortion and envelope/wah filter sweeps
tone.profile: Sharp, articulate clean textures contrasting with jagged, uncompressed high-gain alternative rock crunch
tone.summary: This multi-faceted tone requires pristine clean headroom paired with a specific high-gain distortion footprint. Jonny achieves this by stomping a Marshall ShredMaster into clean tube amps. The signature solos use a combination of aggressive pick attack and a foot-controlled wah or envelope filter sweep.
mustHave: Hard-clipping high-gain distortion (RAT or Marshall ShredMaster style)
Expressive Wah-wah for the aggressive solo sections
Standard tuning (E A D G B E)
gearClues: Vox AC30 and Fender Twin dual-rig setup
corrections: Swapped the generic Fuzz model for a RAT-style distortion block to closer replicate the sharp, biting clipping of Jonny's ShredMaster.
Swapped the US Deluxe amp for the AC30 TB model to accurately capture the specific British high-midrange bite typical of Jonny's live and studio sound.

rig.name: Radiohead - Paranoid Android - Jonny Greenwood Tone
rig.recommendedGuitar: Telecaster or Stratocaster using the bridge humbucker/single-coil for lead sections and middle position for arpeggios

blocks.purpose: Controls single-coil hum and high-gain hiss when switching on the heavy distortion block.
Evens out the fast clean fingerpicked arpeggios in the introductory section.
Essential for manual expressive sweeps during the frantic guitar solos.
Replicates the sharp, aggressive, hard-clipping saturation of Jonny's Marshall ShredMaster pedal.
blocks.gap: GP-180 lacks an exact ShredMaster emulation; the RAT-style circuit is the best approximation for its tight low-end and jagged distortion profile.

alternatives.reason: Standard hard-clipping circuit if a less fuzzy top-end is preferred.

blocks.purpose: Captures the jangly clean chime for the intro and the upper-mid push needed to make the distortion cut through fiercely.

alternatives.reason: Mimics Jonny's clean Fender rig, offering broader headroom but less gritty midrange bite when driven.

blocks.purpose: Pairs perfectly with the AC30 model to supply the vintage, raw speaker characteristics heard on the track.
Fine-tunes high-end sparkle to retain articulation during complex chord voicing shifts.
Bypassed by default; can be used subtly for Ed O'Brien texture simulations if needed.
Provides a faint background echo to expand the space without clouding the rhythm work.
Adds a natural studio room envelope to keep the direct injection or FRFR monitoring feeling lifelike.

improvements.summary: Utilize dedicated premium IRs to capture the vintage Vox/Fender dual-cab blend.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Vox AC30 Alnico Blue 2x12 Third-Party IR
proposals.reason: The factory Foxy 2x12 block is highly usable, but an authentic, high-resolution Alnico Blue IR captures the precise complex high frequencies and woody compression of the vintage amplifier setup used by Radiohead.
proposals.whenToUse: To upgrade the core response realism across both clean and distorted channels.
proposals.expectedGain: Smoother high-end treble frequencies and a more authentic midrange punch when the distortion is activated.
